{{Top|leg}}
The '''Low Altitude Assault Transport/vehicle''', or '''LAAT/v''', was a modified [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]].

It was specially made to hold up to 16 [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] or 8 military [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], among other means of transportation. It was similar to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]], in the sense that they both carried vehicles into battle.
Each LAAT/v had three anti personnel laser cannons and, in some variants, two composite beam laser cannons in the wings.
